notes: none by day; two bandits shake down late travellers after dark

skirmisher bandits in the stair-hall, a caster on the fallen parapet. The caster is the one Hush-speaking hand the Hearthvale bandits have: a Spire dropout, the smuggler-Sayer, gone inland. Five of them, as A Verse About You counts them: the Larkbourne Boys keep hall here.

a pack of bandits with a brute leader. Ryn Larkbourne leads the band in talk, and the Roll of Names sends you to hear Ryn out; the brute who leads it in a fight is the Larkbourne Bruiser, at the fire with the pack. While the errand is to hear Ryn, the band keeps its hands off its knives.

safe ground; a place to lure barrow-wights and watch them turn away. The barrow's nearest dead work the hedges two hundred metres off and are leashed to them, so two come up the hedge line past the gravestones after dark and stop there; the yew's ground (its POI def's ward) is ground the dead will not cross, and a wight whose quarry stands under it turns for home.
a down-wolf pack in the cave behind the falls: the dark mouth at the foot of the face, behind the water
